20: # BK7258 AP 移植 openvela 实施与验证方案
21: 
22: > 文档状态：源码交叉验证后的实施基线。本文区分“已由当前仓库证实”“工程假设”和“量产前待原厂确认”。在 BK7258 专属安全启动、OTP/eFuse 和 CPU1 镜像认证资料闭环前，本文只能指导功能性 AP 移植，不能作为量产安全作业指导书。
23: 
24: ## 1. 目标和结论
25: 
26: 本文给出在 BK7258 上运行 openvela 的可执行移植方案。目标是保留现有 CPU0/CP 固件、bootloader、分区和低层芯片服务，将运行在全芯片 CPU1+CPU2 上的 AP SMP 固件替换为 openvela/NuttX，并完成可启动、可调度、可交互和可打包的内核适配。首版允许先在 AP primary core（物理 CPU1）上完成单核 bring-up，但这只是降低调试复杂度的实验路径，正式 AP 兼容目标仍是 CPU1+CPU2 SMP。
27: 
28: 架构结论必须先固定：BK7258 AP 是 Cortex-M33/ARMv8-M Mainline Thumb，不是 Cortex-A/ARMv8-A。移植必须使用 `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm`、NVIC、SysTick 和 MPU；任何 `arch/arm64`、GIC、AArch64 exception level、generic timer、MMU/页表、TF-A/BL31 或 `OUTPUT_ARCH(aarch64)` 方案均不适用。安全模型应讨论 TrustZone-M、SAU/IDAU、PPC/MPC 和可能的 TF-M，而不是 TF-A/EL3。
29: 
30: 本文只采用一条正式实现路径，不把以下做法作为交付方案：
31: 
32: - 不修改 CP 固件来绕过 AP 启动等待。
33: - 不把 openvela 与 FreeRTOS/Armino AP 固件混链。
34: - 不使用只发送 ready 的临时 mailbox 驱动。
35: - 不通过构建后覆盖临时 `app1.bin` 的方式集成 AP 镜像。
36: - 不在 Secure/Non-secure 地址之间运行时自动选择。
37: - 不关闭 MPU、FPU 来回避架构问题。
38: - 不让 AP 自己初始化 PSRAM。
39: 
40: 正式结论如下：
41: 
42: | 全芯片核 | 正式角色 | 本方案处理方式 |
43: | --- | --- | --- |
44: | CPU0 | CP、系统控制核、原 FreeRTOS 固件 | 原样保留 |
45: | CPU1 | AP primary core，当前 AP 固件第一启动目标 | 首版按现有 SPE 配置验证单核 openvela bring-up；实际安全状态必须实测 |
46: | CPU2 | AP secondary，AP SMP 的第二执行核 | 是否可在首版持续保持 reset 必须由启动链和实板确认；正式兼容目标启用 NuttX SMP |
47: 
48: AP 原 FreeRTOS 工程内部把物理 CPU1 称为逻辑 `core0`，把物理 CPU2 称为逻辑 `core1`。这只是 AP SMP 内部的编号，不能用于替代全芯片 CPU 编号。单核 bring-up 时 openvela 只运行逻辑 CPU index 0，BK mailbox 和系统控制固定使用物理 CPU1 对应资源；进入正式 SMP 阶段后必须建立逻辑 CPU 0/1 与物理 CPU1/CPU2 的稳定映射，并分别处理私有 NVIC、cache、TCM 和跨核启动。
49: 
50: ### 1.1 结论可信度
51: 
52: | 结论 | 状态 | 当前依据或约束 |
53: | --- | --- | --- |
54: | CPU1 是 Cortex-M33、ARMv8-M、hard-float AP 目标 | 已证实 | BK7258 CPU1/AP defconfig 和工具链 |

87: ## 2. 资料和代码依据
88: 
89: ### 2.1 openvela 移植规范
90: 
91: 新平台应按 Architecture、Chip/SoC、Board 三层组织，芯片层负责启动、中断、串口、定时器、堆和芯片寄存器，板级层负责链接脚本、GPIO、控制台和板级初始化：

93: - `openvela/docs/zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md:13-29`
94: - `openvela/docs/zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md:83-114`
95: - `openvela/docs/zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md:452-539`
96: 
97: openvela 已提供 ARMv8-M 公共实现，不应重写 Cortex-M33 的上下文切换：
98: 
99: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/Make.defs:21-45`
100: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/Make.defs:21-50`
101: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_vectors.c`
102: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/arm_initialstate.c`
103: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/arm_doirq.c`
104: 
105: 完整 Cortex-M33 参考平台使用 STM32L5，最小 ARMv8-M/NSH 配置参考 MPS2 AN521：
106: 
107: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/stm32l5/`
108: - `openvela/nuttx/boards/arm/mps/mps2-an521/configs/nsh/defconfig`

110: ### 2.2 BK7258 芯片和三核架构
111: 
112: BK7258 是三核 Cortex-M33 AMP 系统。当前工作区没有原稿所引用的 `bk_idk/docs/bk7258/` 文档目录，因此不能继续把这些路径作为证据；可复核依据改为源码配置：
113: 
114: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258/bk7258.defconfig`
115: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258_cp1/bk7258_cp1.defconfig`
116: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig`
117: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258_cp1/compile-options.cmake`
118: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/compile-options.cmake`
119: 
120: 三个核的资源和角色：
121: 
122: - CPU0 是主核，负责系统控制和主日志输出。
123: - CPU1 通过 mailbox 与 CPU0 通信，主要承载多媒体/AP业务。
124: - CPU1和CPU2组成AP SMP；外设中断可路由到任一物理核，USB等外设的默认路由不能替代正式资源表。
125: - CPU1/AP 编译属性为 `-mcpu=cortex-m33+nodsp -mfpu=fpv5-sp-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard -mcmse`。
126: - 频率上限、TCM容量等产品参数在缺失正式 BK7258 文档时只作为待确认参数，不能作为链接或 timer 的硬编码输入。

129: 
130: 当前 `vendor_beken` 只包含 BK7236N：
131: 
132: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/`
133: - `vendor_beken/boards/bk7236n/bk7236n-evb/`

135: 可复用的是 custom chip/board 组织、Make/CMake 接入模式、`uart_ops_s`、SysTick lower-half，以及用强符号将 BK ISR 注册 ABI 接入 NuttX 的思路：
136: 
137: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/Kconfig`
138: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/Make.defs`
139: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/CMakeLists.txt`
140: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_irq.c`
141: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_interrupt_base.c`
142: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_timerisr.c`
143: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_uart.c`

145: 不得直接复用 BK7236N 的 `bootloader.bin`、`libs/*.a`、IRQ header、UART0 配置、链接脚本和 `bootloader + nuttx_crc.bin` 拼接工具。现有 `beken_head.S` 未被 Make/CMake 源列表可靠加入，链接入口又可能来自预编译 startup 库，因此它只能说明 legacy magic 的布局，不能作为已验证的 BK7258 reset 模板。
146: 
147: ### 2.4 AVDK AP/CP 代码事实
148: 
149: CP 启动 AP 的代码路径：
150: 
151: ```text
152: CP main()
153:   -> bk_init()
154:   -> bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(..., ON)
155:   -> pm_module_bootup_cpu1()
156:   -> start_cpu1_core()
157:   -> reset_cpu1_core()
158:   -> CPU1 从 AP image 启动
159: ```
160: 
161: 证据：
162: 
163: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c:12-24`
164: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:323-374`
165: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:141-202`
166: 
167: CPU1 启动地址由 AP 分区物理地址换算得到：
168: 
169: ```c
170: logical_offset = physical_partition_offset / 34 * 32;
171: boot_address = SOC_FLASH_DATA_BASE + logical_offset;
172: ```
173: 
174: `34` 是 Flash 中 32 字节数据加 2 字节 CRC 的物理占用，代码见：
175: 
176: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:160-170`
177: - `bk_idk/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:141-174`
178: 
179: CP 设置 CPU1 power、boot address 和 software reset：
180: 
181: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:173-195`
182: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258/soc/sys_reg.h:117-141`
183: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c:297-316`
184: 
185: 原 AP 使用 `Reset_Handler_Cpu0` 作为 AP 镜像入口，但 AP 内部第二核实际通过 `reset_cpu2_core()`启动并进入 `Reset_Handler_Cpu1`：
186: 
187: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:86-90`
188: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu1.c:259-318`
189: 
190: 因此，本方案先将 openvela 固件作为由物理 CPU1 引导的 AP 镜像处理。CPU2 在首版是否保持 reset 不是既定硬件事实：实施前必须确认当前启动代码、AP ready和heartbeat是否允许CPU1-only；若不允许，则阶段一就必须提供最小CPU2驻留入口或提前接入NuttX SMP。
191: 
192: ## 3. 固定地址和安全模型
193: 
194: ### 3.1 Secure 地址模型
195: 
196: 当前 AVDK 和 IDK 的 CPU1 配置均启用 `CONFIG_SPE=1`：
197: 
198: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:41-43`
199: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258_cp1/bk7258_cp1.defconfig:29-31`
200: 
201: BK 地址定义使用 Secure alias：
202: 
203: - Secure Flash：`0x02000000`
204: - Secure SRAM：`0x28000000`
205: - Secure PSRAM：`0x60000000`
206: - Secure mailbox：`0x41000000` 和 `0x41020000`
207: 
208: Non-secure 视图整体增加 `0x10000000`，但本方案不使用 Non-secure 视图。openvela 固定配置为 Secure 执行环境，所有镜像、向量、外设和共享内存地址都使用 Secure alias。
209: 
210: openvela 配置含义：
211: 
212: ```text
213: CONFIG_ARCH_TRUSTZONE_DISABLED is not required
214: CONFIG_ARCH_TRUSTZONE_SECURE=y
215: CONFIG_ARMV8M_CMSE=y
216: ```
217: 
218: 这里的“Secure”仅表示首版按现有 AP 的 SPE 编译属性和 Secure alias 建立功能移植基线，不等于镜像已经通过 secure boot，也不等于 CPU1 已被限制在最小权限安全域。原 AP 的 `SystemInitCpu0()` 在 `CONFIG_SPE` 下调用 `TZ_SAU_Setup()`：
219: 
220: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/system_cpu0.c`
221: 
222: 因此 openvela 不能简单省略 SAU 步骤。实施时必须先在 golden AP 上导出 SAU、PPC/MPC/PRRO 和关键访问属性，再决定由 openvela 复现原表，还是由不可变 bootloader 预配置并锁定。IDAU 的固定归属和配置锁定规则需要 TRM 说明。
223: 
224: 当前仓库能证明存在安全工具和配置素材，但不能证明 CPU1 AP 已进入最终认证链：
225: 
226: - `bk_idk/middleware/boards/bk7258/csv/security.csv` 默认 `secureboot_en=FALSE`、`flash_aes_type=NONE`。
227: - `bk_idk/middleware/boards/bk7258/csv/otp1.csv` 定义 key hash、security counter、HUK/IAK 等字段。
228: - `bk_idk/middleware/boards/bk7258/csv/ppc.csv` 和 `mpc.csv` 提供生成素材，但默认值不是经威胁建模的最小权限策略。
229: - `bk_idk/tools/env_tools/beken_utils/scripts/partition.py` 和 `pack.py` 存在 `primary_all` 聚合与签名逻辑。
230: - 默认 BK7258 分区没有形成可复核的 BL2/TF-M/CPU1 安全构建产物，也没有 CPU1 单 bit 篡改后拒绝启动的证据。
231: 
232: 开发阶段保持与 golden CP/bootloader 相同的启动模式，不烧写不可逆 OTP/eFuse，不自行切换 Non-secure image。正式量产必须由 bootloader 提供方确认 CPU1 是独立签名对象还是 `primary_all` 子镜像，并从最终签名输入、TLV/hash范围和实板负向测试三方面证明 AP 字节被覆盖。
233: 
234: ### 3.2 Flash 分区
235: 
236: `projects/app_ab` 当前分区如下：
237: 
238: 来源：`bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv:1-16`
239: 
240: | 分区 | 物理起始 | 物理大小 | CRC解码后的虚拟起始 | 虚拟大小 |
241: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
242: | `primary_bootloader` | `0x000000` | `0x011000` | bootloader管理 | bootloader管理 |
243: | `primary_cp_app` | `0x011000` | `0x154000` | `0x010000` | `0x140000` |
244: | `primary_ap_app` | `0x165000` | `0x121000` | `0x150000` | `0x110000` |
245: 
246: 当前 Secure AP XIP 地址为：
247: 
248: ```text
249: SOC_FLASH_DATA_BASE + CONFIG_AP_VIRTUAL_PARTITION_OFFSET
250: = 0x02000000 + 0x00150000
251: = 0x02150000
252: ```
253: 
254: 最终链接脚本不得长期维护另一份手写地址。`0x02150000`和`0x28010000..0x28064000`只属于当前`app_ab`布局，不是BK7258固定地址。`bk_solution_ai`中的实际AI项目还在`AP_SPINLOCK`之后加入`HARDWARE_ACC`，使AP RAM起点和大小发生变化。建议由目标工程的生成结果转换出最小的 `bk7258_ap_layout.h`，只导出 AP Flash/RAM、保留区和硬件加速区必需宏，再预处理得到 `bk7258_openvela_ap.ld`。不要直接包含整个 BK `sdkconfig.h`，避免和 NuttX `nuttx/config.h` 宏冲突。生成链必须是显式依赖：
255: 
256: ```text
257: target partition CSV
258:   -> BK partition generator
259:   -> partitions_gen.h + ram_regions.h + bk_package.json
260:   -> validate/convert_bk7258_layout
261:   -> bk7258_ap_layout.h
262:   -> preprocess ld.script
263:   -> link openvela AP
264: ```
265: 
266: 干净构建必须先生成布局 header，缺文件或值与 `bk_package.json` 不一致时立即失败。
267: 
268: ### 3.3 SRAM 分区
269: 
270: 当前 `app_ab` SRAM布局来自 `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:2-10`：
271: 
272: | 区域 | 起始地址 | 大小 | 结束地址 | 所有者 |
273: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
274: | `AP_SPINLOCK` | `0x28000000` | `0x10000` | `0x2800ffff` | CP/AP协议保留 |
275: | `AP_RAM` | `0x28010000` | `0x54000` | `0x28063fff` | CPU1 openvela |
276: | `CP_RAM` | `0x28064000` | `0x3b700` | `0x2809f6ff` | CPU0 CP |
277: | `PWR_MNG` | `0x2809f700` | `0x100` | `0x2809f7ff` | CP/AP固定ABI |
278: | `SWAP` | `0x2809f800` | `0x800` | `0x2809ffff` | 系统保留 |
279: 
280: openvela 的主 RAM 只能是：
281: 
282: ```text
283: RAM_START = 0x28010000
284: RAM_END   = 0x28064000
285: RAM_SIZE  = 0x54000
286: ```
287: 
288: 必须禁止：
289: 
290: - 清零 CP_RAM、PWR_MNG、SWAP。
291: - 把 `AP_SPINLOCK` 放入 heap。
292: - 把 mailbox共享 buffer放入 CP_RAM或PWR_MNG。
293: - 让链接器隐式生成 `.itcm`、`.dtcm`、`.psram` alloc section。
294: 
295: ### 3.4 PSRAM所有权
296: 
297: PSRAM映射起点为 `0x60000000`。具体容量必须按目标板PSRAM型号和运行时ID确认；基础`app_ab`和AI解决方案可能分别使用不同容量，不能由芯片型号推断。PSRAM职责必须拆分为PHY/电压/时钟与ID检测、AP多媒体静态区域初始化、AP/CP heap和低功耗投票四层，不能统一描述成“全部由CP初始化”或“全部由AP初始化”。
298: 
299: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:249-369`
300: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:346-382`
301: 
302: 正式规则：
303: 
304: 1. CPU1/openvela不得重复执行与CP冲突的PSRAM PHY、电压、时钟和ID检测初始化；实际执行主体由golden启动链确认。
305: 2. 若原AP在CPU1启动后初始化AP多媒体静态PSRAM区域，openvela必须实现等价步骤或通过正式PWC服务完成，不能因禁用PHY初始化而遗漏AP侧内存管理初始化。
306: 3. CPU1使用动态PSRAM前通过正式PWC协议请求/确认上电，并等待semantic response；不能假设存在独立的异步power-on广播。
307: 4. CPU1状态机确认响应成功后才启用独立PSRAM allocator/pool；不能直接复用依赖FreeRTOS的`CONFIG_PSRAM_AS_SYS_MEMORY`和`psram_malloc()`实现。
308: 5. power-off或recovery前冻结独立allocator；只有受控对象引用计数和outstanding allocation均为0时才确认断电，否则返回busy/fail。
309: 6. PSRAM初始配置为MPU normal non-cacheable；未经共享buffer一致性验证不得打开D-cache。
310: 
311: AP侧不得未经确认直接调用 `bk_psram_init()`、`bk_psram_deinit()` 或 `bk_psram_id_auto_detect()`。开工前必须从golden启动链分别确认PHY初始化、AP静态slab初始化和heap初始化的执行主体。openvela实现基于PWC请求/响应的状态机和独立allocator，不复用FreeRTOS AP的PSRAM heap接口。
312: 
313: 首个可交付版本仍然只使用AP SRAM。NuttX通用heap region注册后通常不能安全注销，也不能迁移任意调用者持有的对象，因此动态可掉电PSRAM不得直接加入通用kernel heap；它是由CP管理、由AP专用allocator控制的可选数据面。
314: 
315: ## 4. 正式启动时序
316: 
317: ### 4.1 CPU0/CP阶段
318: 
319: CP保持原代码，不改变 `projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c`：
320: 
321: 1. Bootloader/CP完成CPU0启动。
322: 2. CP初始化系统时钟、电源管理、UART0、CPU0侧mailbox和必要共享资源。
323: 3. CP按 `PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP`投票打开CPU1。
324: 4. CP清除CPU1 power-down。
325: 5. CP将AP逻辑起始地址写入CPU1 boot offset寄存器。写入值为 `boot_address >> 8`。
326: 6. CP选择CPU1 RXEVT路径，释放CPU1 software reset。
327: 7. CP启动CPU1后存在两套等待：IPC heartbeat任务每次最多等待2秒接收power-up indication，最多打印到`retry_cnt:4`；PWC启动路径等待`PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD`的当前常量为3000 ms，失败最多重试3次。
328: 
329: 代码依据：
330: 
331: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:323-374`
332: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:173-195`
333: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:203-220`
334: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:26-43`
335: 
336: ### 4.2 CPU1/openvela阶段
337: 
338: CPU1 reset handler必须严格按以下顺序执行：
339: 
340: ```text
341: CPU1 boot vector
342:   1. 关闭异常和外部中断
343:   2. 使用 boot vector 提供的 MSP
344:   3. 设置 MSPLIM/栈边界
345:   4. 设置 CPU1 固定身份，不写 CPU0 身份
346:   5. 初始化 Secure CM33 基础状态
347:   6. 设置 CP10/CP11，建立 hard-float运行环境
348:   7. 初始化必要的 TCM/系统 fault 状态
349:   8. 复制 .data 和 runtime vector；首版禁止可执行 .ramfunc
350:   9. 清零 AP 私有 .bss
351:  10. 初始化 MPU
352:  11. 设置 VTOR 到 RAM runtime vector
353:  12. DSB; ISB
354:   13. 仅完成必要的低级Mailbox准备；不调用NuttX IRQ/同步API
355:  14. 调用 nx_start()，不得返回
356:       -> hardware_initialize()
357:          -> irq_initialize()调用BK up_irqinitialize()
358:          -> clock_initialize()调用SysTick lower-half
359:          -> up_initialize()注册UART；mailbox IRQ 79和transport正式目标在此时初始化
360:       -> nx_bringup()/board late
361:           -> 初始化MBOX0 channel 1 FIFO和IRQ79
362:           -> 初始化CPU1->CPU0 IPC HW_CTRL channel
363:           -> 启动IPC power-up和2秒heartbeat服务
364:           -> 创建PM worker并等待worker_ready握手
365:           -> open MB_CHNL_PWC
366:           -> 发送一次 PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD(1, 0, 0)
367: ```
368: 
369: 这个顺序的依据是：
370: 
371: - C代码调用前必须先完成SP、C runtime和FPU状态。
372: - MPU必须在NuttX访问heap和外设前建立，但runtime vector复制必须在MPU限制生效前完成或放在允许区域。
373: - VTOR必须在NVIC开启前切换，避免中断进入错误向量。
374: - reset阶段不能调用 `irq_attach()`、NuttX spinlock/semaphore或创建worker，因为 `irq_initialize()`、memory和scheduler尚未完成。mailbox必须在 `up_initialize()` 后具备完整RX/ACK能力；PWC复杂动作由PM worker执行，因为CP可能在ready后立即发送命令。
375: - 不得在 `nx_start()`返回后手工调用 `irq_initialize()`、`clock_initialize()`或 `up_initialize()`；这些步骤是上面展示的内部调用链，`nx_start()`正常情况下不返回。
376: - `nx_start()`会初始化NuttX的任务、IRQ、clock和硬件，并最终创建应用启动流程，见 `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:658-826`。
377: 
378: ready的正式含义是：CPU1已经具备持续运行、响应CP IPC/PWC命令并发送heartbeat的能力，不表示NSH或所有应用已启动。CPU1必须先发送兼容Armino的IPC power-up indication；ready发送必须在NuttX调度器、Mailbox RX路径、IPC heartbeat和PM worker具备后执行，禁止只发送一个裸ready消息。
379: 
380: ### 4.3 NuttX启动阶段
381: 
382: 进入 `nx_start()`后的调用顺序：
383: 
384: ```text
385: nx_start()
386:   -> tasklist_initialize()
387:   -> memory_initialize()
388:   -> hardware_initialize()
389:        -> irq_initialize()
390:        -> clock_initialize()
391:        -> up_initialize()
392:        -> drivers_initialize()
393:        -> board_early_initialize()
394:   -> nx_bringup()
395:        -> board_late_initialize()
396:        -> nsh_main()
397: ```
398: 
399: 对应实现位置：
400: 
401: - `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:757-826`
402: - `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_bringup.c:293-501`
403: 
404: BK特有的CPU1身份、MPU和vector属于reset阶段；NuttX IRQ注册、UART正式设备和mailbox transport正式目标属于 `up_initialize()`；PM worker、PWC命令语义和ready发送属于board bring-up。UART不在board late重复注册。这样既符合NuttX生命周期，也保证ready发出时调度器和RX路径已可用。
405: 
406: 当前实现偏差：`bk7258_mbox_init()`（含 `irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, ...)` 和 `up_enable_irq()`）实际在 `board_late_initialize()` -> `bk7258_pwc_start()` 中调用，而不是在 `up_initialize()` 中。`up_irqinitialize()` 只注册异常向量和设置优先级，不注册 mailbox IRQ。这意味着 mailbox RX 路径在 board late 之前不可用；如果 CP 在此窗口发送 PWC 命令，消息会堆积在 FIFO 中。后续应将 mailbox 物理层和 IRQ 注册前移到 `up_initialize()` 阶段，board late 只负责逻辑 channel open 和 worker 启动。
407: 
408: ## 5. 双向量镜像设计
409: 
410: ### 5.1 必须保留Flash boot vector
411: 
412: CPU1 boot address直接指向AP镜像起点，因此镜像offset 0必须是有效的 Cortex-M vector：
413: 
414: - word 0：AP RAM范围内的初始MSP。
415: - word 1：位于AP Flash的Thumb reset handler地址；仅凭该值不能证明Secure state。
416: 
417: 原BK镜像在offset `0x100`保留 `BK7236` legacy download magic：
418: 
419: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu0.c:229-231`
420: 
421: 外部IRQ向量表中的该位置会被magic覆盖，因此不能把这份Flash表作为运行时完整向量。
422: 
423: ### 5.2 RAM runtime vector
424: 
425: 正式链接脚本定义两套内容：
426: 
427: ```text
428: .bk_boot_vectors
429:   VMA/LMA: Flash image offset 0
430:   内容: MSP、Reset、bootloader magic兼容布局
431: 
432: .vectors
433:   LMA: Flash
434:   VMA: AP SRAM固定区域
435:   内容: 完整NuttX ARMv8-M向量表
436: ```
437: 
438: Reset handler完成 `.vectors` 从 Flash LMA复制到 AP SRAM VMA，然后设置 `SCB->VTOR`并执行：
439: 
440: ```c
441: __DSB();
442: __ISB();
443: ```
444: 
445: 芯片 Kconfig 必须选择 `ARCH_HAVE_CUSTOM_VECTORS`。不能直接启用NuttX通用 `CONFIG_ARCH_RAMVECTORS`，因为其实现会从当前Flash vector逐项复制：
446: 
447: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_ramvec_initialize.c:77-105`
448: 
449: 当前Flash vector含magic时，这会把magic复制成IRQ handler。正式配置关闭通用RAM vector复制，由BK7258芯片层自行完成一次独立的runtime vector安装。
450: 
451: runtime vector可按NuttX公共vector定义生成，但必须作为独立对象放入 `.ram_vectors`，不能从boot table复制：
452: 
453: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_vectors.c:102-127`
454: 
455: 链接器必须对两套vector执行512字节对齐断言，原BK脚本已有相同要求：
456: 
457: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:94-114`

564: ### 6.3 IRQ
565: 
566: BK7258 AP IRQ表来源：
567: 
568: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/icu_map.h:28-94`
569: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/bk7258_ap/interrupt.c:114-245`
570: 
571: 已确认的外部NVIC line：
572: 
573: | 外设 | 外部line | NuttX IRQ |
574: | --- | ---: | ---: |
575: | TIMER0 | 3 | 19 |
576: | UART0 | 4 | 20 |
577: | TIMER1 | 13 | 29 |
578: | UART1 | 15 | 31 |
579: | UART2 | 16 | 32 |
580: | MAILBOX统一ICU source | 63 | 79 |
581: 
582: openvela `bk7258_irq.c`实现：
583: 
584: - `up_irqinitialize()`：关闭所有外部IRQ、设置VTOR、配置默认priority、绑定SVC/HardFault/BusFault/UsageFault/MemFault/SecureFault、最后开启中断。
585: - `up_enable_irq()`：按NVIC ISER或系统异常寄存器开启。
586: - `up_disable_irq()`：按NVIC ICER或系统异常寄存器关闭。
587: - `up_prioritize_irq()`：按NVIC优先级寄存器设置。
588: - `arm_ack_irq()`：NVIC无需单独ack，外设ISR负责清设备pending。
589: 
590: BK7258外部中断不是只配置NVIC即可，必须实现完整三级路径：
591: 
592: ```text
593: 外设中断源
594:   -> 系统控制层将source路由到物理CPU1或CPU2
595:   -> 目标core私有NVIC external line
596:   -> NuttX IRQ编号和ISR
597: ```
598: 
599: 例如mailbox必须完成`source 63 -> CPU1系统路由 -> NVIC line 63 -> NuttX IRQ 79`。只在`irq.h`定义编号不能使中断到达CPU1。进入SMP阶段后，每个外设还必须明确唯一owner或共享路由策略，不能让CPU1和CPU2同时无保护处理同一外设中断；AP日志使用Mailbox UART逻辑通道，不要求CPU1接管物理UART1中断。
600: 
601: 必须在 `include/irq.h` 固化两个编号域，例如 `BK7258_EXTIRQ_MAILBOX=63`、`BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX=BK7258_IRQ_FIRST+63=79`，并设置 `NR_IRQS=80`。`irq_attach()`使用79，NVIC bit和BK gate使用63。`IRQ_MAILBOX0=48`、`IRQ_MAILBOX1=49`等旧header注释不能代替CPU1最终映射。
602: 
603: 还必须区分两套“group”命名：`icu_map.h`中的逻辑group与系统寄存器0-31/32-63 enable bank不是同一概念。mailbox driver实际对source 63调用 `sys_drv_core_intr_group2_enable(..., 1 << (63 - 32))`，即打开32-63 bank的bit31。文档和实现均应使用“32-63 bank”描述寄存器，避免写成含糊的GROUP1。
604: 
605: ### 6.4 Timer
606: 
607: 系统tick固定使用 Cortex-M SysTick：
608: 
609: - `CONFIG_TIMER=y`
610: - `CONFIG_ARMV8M_SYSTICK=y`
611: - `CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000`
612: - `CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS`关闭
613: 
614: 优先复用openvela ARMv8-M SysTick lower-half，而不是自写旧式ISR直接调用 `nxsched_process_timer()`：
615: 
616: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_timerisr.c`
617: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/Kconfig`
618: 
619: `up_timer_initialize()`调用 `systick_initialize(true, CONFIG_CPU_FREQ_HZ, -1)`，再调用 `up_timer_set_lowerhalf()`。
620: 
621: 首版固定CPU1频率，不支持runtime DVFS，直到确认CP通知发生在频率切换前还是后、SysTick时钟源及时间补偿协议。仅暂停并重装reload会丢tick，不能作为正式DVFS实现。后续必须设计pre-change/post-change握手、临界区更新和已流逝时间补偿测试后再启用。
622: 
623: 不把BK TIMER0同时用于系统tick，避免与CP和外设共享同一timer资源。
624: 
625: ### 6.5 AP日志转发到CP UART0
626: 
627: 正式物理日志口使用CP UART0。AP日志目标路径是Mailbox虚拟UART转发到CP，由CP侧UART0统一输出；当前OpenVela代码仍需完成正式Mailbox UART log driver，不能把设计目标写成已验收事实：
628: 
629: - AP通过Mailbox UART逻辑通道向CP发送日志数据。
630: - CP接收后通过UART0输出到开发板的物理日志口。
631: - CP UART0：115200 8N1。
632: - CPU1不接管GPIO0/1，不启用UART1作为AP console。
633: 
634: UART0是板上的物理日志口：BK7258 UART0 TX/RX 经 CH340 USB转串口芯片接到 Type-C 接口，PC 端通过 Type-C 枚举出 CH340 串口设备接收日志。因此 CP 的所有 log、AP 经Mailbox转发的 log，以及烧录工具的下载通信，都通过这条 UART0->CH340->Type-C->PC 物理链路完成。OpenVela AP不建立独立的UART1控制台。
635: 
636: 地址和GPIO映射见：
637: 
638: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h:26-40`
639: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h:169-179`
640: 
641: 当前 `app_ab` AP GPIO配置把GPIO0/1作为I2C1，见：
642: 
643: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/ap/config/bk7258_ap/usr_gpio_cfg.h:22-25`
644: 
645: 正式OpenVela board配置不应接管GPIO0/1为UART1，保留CP侧UART0和现有AP GPIO资源配置。CP GPIO配置不修改。当前`bk7258_lowputc.c`仍把GPIO0/1配置为UART1，必须在Mailbox UART日志转发完成后删除该临时路径。
646: 
647: 芯片层实现：
648: 
649: - `bk7258_lowputc.c`：当前仍是UART1 polling实现，只用于临时bring-up；正式版本必须改为Mailbox可用后的转发或仅保留最小故障状态，不得把UART1作为交付console。
650: - `bk7258_mailbox_channel.c`：承载Mailbox逻辑命令和PWC；Mailbox UART log driver仍是后续缺口，必须复用Armino `mb_uart_driver.c`的通道、缓冲和流控语义。
651: - AP侧日志转发不得阻塞Mailbox中断，也不能在中断上下文执行复杂格式化。
652: - CP侧使用现有UART0 log driver输出到物理串口；AP不注册物理UART1 console。
653: 
654: AP控制台目标必须依赖CPU0 mailbox日志转发，因为网页文档规定BK7258 AP日志通过Mailbox发送到CP，再由CP侧日志串口输出。ready之前的启动故障日志暂不能承诺可见；不能另行切换到UART1作为正式路径。
655: 
656: 官方AP日志路径通过Mailbox转发到CP的UART0。控制台只保留一条正式路径：AP日志经Mailbox虚拟UART发送，CP通过UART0输出。必须区分Mailbox虚拟UART和CPU1物理UART1，不能把二者混用。
657: 
658: #### 6.5.1 本轮方案：仅使用开发板UART0
659: 
660: 本轮开发板只有一条可连接电脑的物理串口，因此暂不使用CPU1物理UART1。正式调试路径固定为：
661: 
662: ```text
663: OpenVela CPU1
664:   -> AP syslog/console backend
665:   -> Mailbox UART logical channel
666:   -> MBOX0 shared buffer and ACK
667:   -> CP Mailbox UART receiver
668:   -> CP UART0 log/output driver
669:   -> GPIO11/UART0_TX
670:   -> CH340/USB Type-C/PC
671: ```
672: 
673: UART1在本方案中不是备用控制台，而是明确禁用的临时bring-up路径：
674: 
675: - 不把GPIO0/1切换为UART1。
676: - 不注册物理UART1为`/dev/console`。
677: - 不要求第二个USB-TTL或额外串口设备。
678: - AP的NSH标准输入、标准输出和标准错误均通过Mailbox虚拟UART连接到CP UART0。
679: - CP原有UART0日志、CP Shell和AP转发日志共享同一物理输出路径；输出必须保持可区分的`ap0`前缀，避免把AP日志误认为CP日志。
680: 
681: #### 6.5.2 参考协议和通道选择
682: 
683: 实现前必须从Armino源代码确认以下内容，禁止仅根据`MB_CHNL_LOG`名称自行定义新协议：
684: 
685: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mb_uart/`或对应`mb_uart_driver.c`的实际路径、逻辑通道和消息结构。
686: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mb_uart.h`及相关类型、状态码和回调语义。
687: - CP侧对应的Mailbox UART接收、发送和UART0输出实现。
688: - `博通网页文档/多核通讯-Uart通讯接口 — 博通集成 ARMINO SMP开发框架 文档.html`中`MB_UART0`的初始化、读写、TX/RX回调和溢出语义。
689: - AP/CP两侧的共享buffer位置、长度、32字节对齐要求、缓存属性和buffer所有权。
690: 
691: 优先复用Armino已有的`MB_UART0`作为AP到CP的日志输出通道。只有在源码交叉验证确认`MB_UART0`不是CPU1到CPU0日志方向时，才选择对应的日志逻辑通道；不能把IPC `0x10`或PWC通道复用于日志。
692: 
693: #### 6.5.3 AP侧分层设计
694: 
695: AP侧应拆成三个层次，避免在syslog路径直接操作MBOX寄存器：
696: 
697: 1. **Mailbox UART transport**：负责标准logical channel、共享buffer、sequence、transport ACK、FIFO full、reset和错误计数。
698: 2. **NuttX serial/syslog backend**：将`/dev/console`、`/dev/ttyS0`或等价的NuttX console设备映射到Mailbox UART虚拟设备；具体设备名以NuttX配置和驱动注册方式为准，不预先假定`ttyS0`。
699: 3. **NSH和syslog使用层**：让`nsh_main`使用同一虚拟console，syslog输出复用同一路径；禁止为NSH另建UART1物理后端。
700: 
701: 日志数据路径要求：
702: 
703: - 普通日志在任务上下文写入有界环形TX队列，由Mailbox UART worker异步发送。
704: - Mailbox ISR只完成FIFO drain、消息校验、transport ACK和事件投递，不格式化日志、不等待semaphore、不执行文件系统操作。
705: - TX队列满时采用明确策略：普通日志丢弃并累计计数；错误日志优先但仍受有界队列和单条最大长度限制；不能无限阻塞影响heartbeat和系统启动。
706: - 日志消息必须支持换行、连续短消息合并和单条消息分片；分片不得破坏消息边界或复用仍处于in-flight状态的共享buffer。
707: - AP启动早期在NuttX mailbox transport正式可用前，不承诺完整日志转发；如保留最小故障路径，必须是有界、无阻塞、不会接管GPIO0/1的机制。
708: - AP日志应由CP侧统一添加或保留`ap0`来源标识，并禁止在AP和CP两侧重复添加前缀。
709: 
710: #### 6.5.4 CP侧接收和UART0输出
711: 
712: CP侧保持原有UART0硬件和GPIO配置，不修改`projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/usr_gpio_cfg.h`。Mailbox UART接收服务应：
713: 
714: - 在Mailbox接收路径完成source、destination、长度、对齐、地址窗口和sequence校验。
715: - 对有效日志完成transport ACK后，将数据投递到CP日志输出队列；不在Mailbox ISR中直接阻塞写UART0。
716: - 由CP日志任务按原有UART0驱动输出，保持115200 8N1和现有CP Shell行为。
717: - 正确处理AP重启、旧消息、重复ACK、FIFO full和reset重同步，避免旧AP日志污染新一轮启动。
718: - 对AP日志转发失败保留计数和最后错误原因；诊断信息不能反过来依赖同一条已经失效的Mailbox日志通道。
719: 
720: #### 6.5.5 启动时序和ready约束
721: 
722: 日志转发服务不能改变CPU1启动契约：
723: 
724: ```text
725: CPU1 reset
726:   -> NuttX基础启动和UART0-independent console backend准备
727:   -> MBOX0物理层、IRQ79和RX drain可用
728:   -> Mailbox UART logical channel建立
729:   -> AP日志TX队列和worker就绪
730:   -> IPC power-up indication
731:   -> heartbeat worker
732:   -> PWC worker
733:   -> PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD
734:   -> NSH启动并使用Mailbox console
735: ```
736: 
737: 其中`IPC power-up indication`和heartbeat仍使用`MB_CHNL_HW_CTRL`，Mailbox UART日志不得覆盖、复用或改变这两个IPC command。`PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD`只能在日志worker、Mailbox RX路径和PWC worker均已可运行后发送，但日志worker失败不能通过无界等待阻塞heartbeat；应记录失败并按预先定义的降级策略继续或停止ready。
738: 
739: #### 6.5.6 分阶段实施和验收
740: 
741: 本轮review通过后按以下顺序实施：
742: 
743: 1. **协议确认**：从Armino AP/CP源码确认MB_UART0方向、channel ID、消息格式、buffer和回调语义，形成AP/CP字段对照表。
744: 2. **只读验证**：先在OpenVela中保留UART1代码但不启用，增加Mailbox UART最小发送测试；测试数据不能接管GPIO0/1。
745: 3. **AP transport**：实现对齐共享buffer、TX队列、分片、ACK、超时、FIFO full和reset状态机。
746: 4. **CP接收桥接**：接入现有CP UART0日志任务，验证CP日志和AP日志并发输出不互相破坏。
747: 5. **NuttX console接入**：将NSH console、syslog和`up_putc`的正式后端切换到Mailbox UART；删除或禁用UART1 console注册和GPIO0/1 pinmux。
748: 6. **启动诊断**：在Mailbox不可用阶段只保留最小故障计数；确认正常启动后AP日志和`nsh>`均能从UART0观察到。
749: 7. **压力验收**：验证连续日志、长行分片、队列满、AP复位、CP复位、Mailbox reset、heartbeat并发和CP Shell输入。
750: 
751: 最低验收日志：
752: 
753: ```text
754: CP UART0: CP boot log
755: CP UART0: ap0: OpenVela early/bringup log
756: CP UART0: ap0: mailbox uart ready
757: CP UART0: nsh>
758: ```
759: 
760: 必须同时满足：
761: 
762: - 只有UART0连接电脑即可完成日志观察和NSH交互。
763: - GPIO0/1没有被OpenVela切换为UART1。
764: - 连续运行期间不出现IPC heartbeat timeout。
765: - 日志压力不能导致Mailbox TX buffer覆盖、PWC卡死或CP UART0异常。
766: - AP重启后旧日志不会在新一轮启动中重复输出。

768: ### 6.6 MPU、FPU和cache
769: 
770: 正式配置启用：
771: 
772: ```text
773: CONFIG_ARM_MPU=y
774: CONFIG_ARM_MPU_RESET=y
775: CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y
776: CONFIG_ARMV8M_CMSE=y
777: CONFIG_ARM_DSP is not set
778: ```
779: 
780: MPU region不是原BK宽范围表的原样复制，而是基于其memory attribute重新收紧所有权。region数量必须从MPU `TYPE.DREGION`读回，显式写入 `CONFIG_ARM_MPU_NREGIONS`并在启动时校验；在TRM或实测前不得写死16，也不能盲目分配超过硬件能力的region。若region不足，首版只保留Flash、AP SRAM、外设和必需共享窗口，PSRAM/QSPI后置。目标策略：
781: 
782: | 区域 | 地址 | 属性 |
783: | --- | --- | --- |
784: | Flash | `0x02000000-0x02ffffff` | Secure RO/X，write-through |
785: | AP instruction alias | `0x08000000-0x0809ffff` | RO/X |
786: | DTCM | `0x20000000-0x20003fff` | RW/XN，non-cacheable |
787: | AP SRAM | `0x28010000-0x28063fff` | RW/XN，shareable；不得包含CP RAM |
788: | PWR_MNG | `0x2809f700-0x2809f7ff` | RW，Device，shareable |
789: | peripheral | `0x40000000-0x5fffffff` | Device，XN，shareable |
790: | PSRAM | `0x60000000-0x63ffffff` | RW/XN，non-cacheable |
791: | QSPI0 | `0x64000000-0x67ffffff` | non-cacheable，XN |
792: | QSPI1 | `0x68000000-0x6bffffff` | non-cacheable，XN |
793: 
794: 参考：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/mpu_cfg.c:38-149`。原表将SRAM覆盖到 `0x3fffffff`，不能提供AP/CP边界；PWR_MNG若作为AP SRAM region的override，必须明确更高优先级region编号。首版禁止 `.ramfunc`，避免与SRAM整体XN策略矛盾。
795: 
796: FPU从reset阶段启用CP10/CP11，所有对象统一hard-float。NuttX公共层负责线程浮点上下文保存，不能把FPU支持延后到另一个ABI。
797: 
798: I-cache和D-cache在正式第一版保持关闭，因为现有 `mbox0_adapter.c`在发送端没有与接收端对称的D-cache clean/invalidate：
799: 
800: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:15-38`
801: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:99-128`
802: 
803: 后续若启用D-cache，必须先将mailbox共享buffer放到non-cacheable MPU region，或者为发送、接收和所有权交接实现完整32字节cache line clean/invalidate、DMB和DSB。

805: ## 7. Mailbox v2和PWC服务
806: 
807: ### 7.1 不能使用旧版裸mailbox
808: 
809: AP配置明确启用 `CONFIG_MAILBOX_V2_0`：
810: 
811: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:28-30`
812: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/common/CMakeLists.txt:71-81`
813: 
814: mailbox v2的实际数据链为：
815: 
816: ```text
817: logical command
818:   -> mailbox_channel物理头
819:   -> AP共享SRAM buffer
820:   -> MBOX0 FIFO发送buffer pointer + length
821:   -> 对端从共享SRAM读取16字节message
822:   -> command/ACK状态机
823: ```
824: 
825: 证据：
826: 
827: - physical header含 `cmd/state/ctrl/tx_seq/logical_chnl`：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:51-71`
828: - logical TX写入sequence和logical channel：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:207-223`
829: - mailbox发送共享buffer指针和长度：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:99-128`
830: - MBOX0 FIFO长度和channel配置：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c:6-27`
831: - 当前AP CMake编译v2驱动：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/CMakeLists.txt:392-423`

833: ### 7.2 CPU1必须实现的transport
834: 
835: openvela芯片层必须完整移植以下逻辑，不能仅保留ready或仅发送裸指针消息：
836: 
837: 1. `mbox0_ll.h`、`mbox0_struct.h`、`mbox0_hal.c`对应的寄存器和FIFO操作。
838: 2. CPU1 channel的FIFO起始地址、长度和owner配置。
839: 3. `INT_SRC_MAILBOX`外部line 63到NuttX IRQ 79的注册、32-63 gate使能、清pending和FIFO drain。
840: 4. RX FIFO中所有message的循环读取，不能每次中断只取一个。
841: 5. 发送共享buffer池，command和ACK独立且32字节对齐；当前实现使用固定对齐发送buffer，仍需补充严格的in-flight/已消费所有权和并发保护，不能把当前实现宣称为完整buffer池。
842: 6. physical message的pointer/length envelope；接收时检查source、destination、指针窗口、对齐、长度、加法溢出和buffer所有权。
843: 7. logical channel source/destination编码。
844: 8. `tx_seq`递增、reset和重新同步。
845: 9. `CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX`、`CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX`和`CHNL_CTRL_RESET`处理。
846: 10. command RX、ACK RX、发送完成和busy状态机；当前板级实现已具备基础RX drain和发送路径，完整ACK/reset/busy恢复仍待实测。
847: 11. NuttX临界区/spinlock保护，禁止使用FreeRTOS临界区和semaphore。
848: 12. transport错误计数、超时、FIFO full、非法source/destination和reset恢复。

850: 应以这些文件为协议移植依据，而不是自行重新定义格式：
851: 
852: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c`
853: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c`
854: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/common/hal/mbox0_hal.c`
855: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/mbox0_ll.h`
856: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c`
857: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h`

859: CPU1的逻辑身份固定：
860: 
861: ```c
862: #define SELF_CPU MAILBOX_CPU1
863: ```
864: 
865: PWC是CPU1到CPU0的逻辑channel：
866: 
867: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:47-100`

869: ### 7.2.1 CPU1 IPC启动握手
870: 
871: CPU0在启动CPU1后不会只等待`PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD`。CP侧`mb_ipc_heartbeat.c`先等待CPU1通过`MB_CHNL_HW_CTRL`发送IPC power-up indication，再接受后续heartbeat；缺少该消息时会出现：
872: 
873: ```text
874: IPC retry to start core1, retry_cnt:N
875: ```
876: 
877: 协议必须保持与Armino `ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.h`一致：
878: 
879: | 消息 | command | 方向 | logical channel | 参数 |
880: | --- | ---: | --- | ---: | --- |
881: | `IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION` | `1` | CPU1 -> CPU0 | `0x10` (`MB_CHNL_HW_CTRL`) | 0, 0, 0 |
882: | `IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION` | `2` | CPU1 -> CPU0 | `0x10` (`MB_CHNL_HW_CTRL`) | 0, 0, 0 |
883: 
884: CPU1首次完成Mailbox初始化后必须先发送command 1；heartbeat服务随后每2秒发送command 2。两条消息使用标准16字节logical command结构和同一共享buffer envelope，不得重新定义为只含command的裸mailbox word。IPC power-up和heartbeat是CPU启动契约，不能由PWC ready替代。
885: 
886: ### 7.2.2 当前mailbox实现的已知缺口
887: 
888: 以下缺口必须在下一次上板验证前修复，当前代码不能宣称为完整mailbox v2 transport：
889: 
890: 1. **RX指针校验窗口错误**：`bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:42-43` 校验 `address < 0x28010000u || address + sizeof(message) > 0x28064000u`，即只接受AP RAM范围的指针。但Armino协议中CP发送的消息指针指向CP SRAM（`0x28064000..0x2809f700`），因此所有CP->AP的PWC命令会被静默丢弃。校验窗口必须覆盖CP SRAM或使用Armino `mb_chnl_buff.c`的共享buffer分配方案。
891: 
892: 2. **IPC TX使用单buffer**：`bk7258_mbox0.c:71` 的 `bk7258_mbox_send_message()` 使用单个 `static uint32_t message[4]`。如果IPC power-up和heartbeat或PWC ready在CP读取前连续发送，后一条会覆盖前一条的共享buffer内容。PWC TX路径（`bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:31`）有4个buffer并按 `g_tx_seq` 轮转，但IPC路径没有。
893: 
894: 3. **发送端不消费transport ACK**：`bk7258_mbox_send_message()` 和 `bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc()` 发送后直接返回，不等待也不处理CP返回的transport ACK。Armino协议要求发送方在 `tx_cmpl_isr` 中匹配ACK sequence后才能释放buffer所有权。当前实现无法检测发送失败、超时或reset恢复。
895: 
896: 4. **worker_ready忙等待无界**：`bk7258_pm_pwc.c:120-123` 使用 `while (!g_worker_ready) { sched_yield(); }` 等待PWC worker就绪。如果worker线程创建失败或被永久抢占，此循环不会退出。应改为有界等待（如 `nxsem_timedwait`）或检查 `kthread_create` 返回值后直接失败。
897: 
898: 5. **mailbox IRQ注册时序偏差**：`bk7258_mbox_init()` 在 `board_late_initialize()` 中调用，而非 `up_initialize()` 阶段。这意味着 `up_irqinitialize()` 完成后、board late执行前，mailbox IRQ 79尚未注册，CP在此窗口发送的PWC命令会堆积在FIFO中。
899: 
900: ### 7.3 PWC方向和命令服务
901: 
902: PWC命令定义：
903: 
904: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:26-43`
905: 
906: PWC不能按“CPU1收到后执行”统一描述。CP/AP两侧源码表明power/clock/frequency主要是AP向CP请求，由CP执行系统硬件动作并返回；ready由AP发送；PSRAM/recovery存在CP向AP通知。编码前必须为每个命令从两侧调用点生成完整协议表，至少包含request direction、执行主体、3个参数、transport ACK、semantic response、timeout和recovery。已确认的主方向：

911: | `PM_CLK_CTRL_CMD` | AP -> CP | CP执行主时钟操作；AP处理响应 |

913: | `PM_CPU_FREQ_CTRL_CMD` | AP -> CP | CP执行频率操作；首版AP固定频率并拒绝未支持的DVFS |

1: # BK7258 最终固件构建步骤
2: 
3: 本文记录当前工作区已经验证通过的构建流程。最终固件由以下三部分组成：
4: 
5: ```text
6: OpenVela CPU1/AP nuttx.bin
7: Armino CPU0/CP app.bin
8: Beken bootloader.bin
9:         |
10:         v
11: Beken packager
12:         |
13:         v
14: all-app.bin
15: ```
16: 
17: OpenVela 只构建 AP raw binary。CP、bootloader、分区生成和最终打包均由
18: `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab` 完成。不要手工覆盖打包目录中的 `app1.bin`，
19: 应使用已经接入的 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 接口。
20: 
21: ## 1. 前置条件
22: 
23: 工作区路径：
24: 
25: ```text
26: /home/mi/vela_competition/contest
27: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
28: ```
29: 
30: 确认官方 Armino 1.5 Podman 镜像存在：
31: 
32: ```bash
33: podman images
34: ```
35: 
36: 应包含：
37: 
38: ```text
39: localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5
40: ```
41: 
42: `app_ab` 使用自己的分区配置：
43: 
44: ```text
45: bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv
46: bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
47: ```
48: 
49: 不得混用 `bk_solution_ai` 等其他项目的分区文件。
50: 
51: ## 2. 构建 OpenVela AP
52: 
53: ```bash
54: cd /home/mi/vela_competition/contest
55: 
56: ./build.sh \
57:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
58:   -e -Werror \
59:   --cmake \
60:   -j8
61: ```
62: 
63: 如修改过 `Kconfig` 或 `defconfig`，建议先删除旧 CMake 配置：
64: 
65: ```bash
66: ./build.sh \
67:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
68:   --cmake distclean
69: ```
70: 
71: 实际输出：
72: 
73: ```text
74: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx       # ELF
75: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin   # AP raw binary
76: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/System.map
77: ```
78: 
79: 检查 AP 文件：
80: 
81: ```bash
82: stat -c '%s %y %n' cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin
83: sha256sum cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin
84: ```
85: 
86: AP 必须使用 Cortex-M33 hard-float 配置，链接地址必须与 `app_ab` 的 AP
87: 布局匹配，并且 `nuttx.bin` 不得超过 AP 分区容量。
88: 
89: ## 3. 准备外部 AP 输入
90: 
91: Podman 只挂载 `bk_avdk_smp`，因此先把 AP raw binary 复制到 SDK 内部：
92: 
93: ```bash
94: cp \
95:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
96:   /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
97: ```
98: 
99: 确认源文件和复制结果一致：
100: 
101: ```bash
102: sha256sum \
103:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
104:   /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
105: ```
106: 
107: ## 4. 构建 CP 并打包最终固件
108: 
109: 在 `bk_avdk_smp` 根目录执行：
110: 
111: ```bash
112: cd /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
113: 
114: podman run --rm \
115:   --userns=keep-id \
116:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \
117:   -w /armino \
118:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
119:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
120:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
121:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
122: ```
123: 
124: 该命令自动完成：
125: 
126: 1. 生成 `app_ab` 分区文件。
127: 2. 构建 Armino CPU0/CP。
128: 3. 获取 Beken bootloader。
129: 4. 将 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 复制为打包输入 `app1.bin`。
130: 5. 调用标准 Beken packager 生成最终固件。
131: 
132: 仅安装 Podman 时不要使用会在内部调用 Docker 的 `dbuild.sh`。
133: 
134: ## 5. 输出文件
135: 
136: 完整烧录固件：
137: 
138: ```text
139: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin
140: ```
141: 
142: OTA 固件：
143: 
144: ```text
145: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/app_ab_crc.rbl
146: ```
147: 
148: 最终打包输入：
149: 
150: ```text
151: package/tmp/bootloader.bin  # Beken bootloader
152: package/tmp/app.bin         # Armino CPU0/CP
153: package/tmp/app1.bin        # OpenVela CPU1/AP
154: ```
155: 
156: 实际完整路径的共同前缀为：
157: 
158: ```text
159: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/
160: ```
161: 
162: ## 6. 构建后校验
163: 
164: 首先确认最终文件存在：
165: 
166: ```bash
167: ls -lh \
168:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin \
169:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/app_ab_crc.rbl
170: ```
171: 
172: 然后确认 packager 使用了本次构建的 OpenVela AP：
173: 
174: ```bash
175: sha256sum \
176:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
177:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
178:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
179: 
180: cmp -s \
181:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
182:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
183: ```
184: 
185: 三个 SHA256 必须一致，`cmp` 必须返回 0。否则生成的 `all-app.bin` 可能仍包含旧 AP。
186: 
187: 检查分区和构建摘要：
188: 
189: ```bash
190: cat projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/bk_package.json
191: cat projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/build_summary.txt
192: ```
193: 
194: `bk_package.json` 应包含：
195: 
196: ```text
197: bootloader.bin -> bootloader
198: app.bin        -> CPU0/CP app
199: app1.bin       -> CPU1/AP app
200: ```
201: 
202: 注意：`build_summary.txt` 中的 AP memory info 来自构建过程中的 Armino AP
203: 占位镜像 map，不用于证明外部 OpenVela AP 已经打包。外部 AP 是否生效必须以
204: `nuttx.bin`、`build/openvela-ap.bin` 和 `package/tmp/app1.bin` 的哈希及
205: 逐字节比较为准。
206: 
207: ## 7. 常见问题
208: 
209: - OpenVela CMake 构建产物是 `nuttx.bin` 和 `System.map`，不是
210:   `vela_nuttx.bin` 或 `nuttx.map`。
211: - 当前 OpenVela 工作树是 `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest`，不是旧的
212:   `openvela_bk7258_dev`。
213: - `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 必须填写容器内路径
214:   `/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin`，不能填写宿主机绝对路径。
215: - 修改配置后若增量构建没有加载新配置，先执行 CMake `distclean`。
216: - 最终烧录文件名是 `all-app.bin`，不是 `all_app.bin`。

76: /****************************************************************************
77:  * Name: fifo_drain
78:  *
79:  * Description:
80:  *   Drain all data in the inter-processor FIFO
81:  ****************************************************************************/
82: 
83: static void fifo_drain(void)
84: {
85:   putreg32(0, RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST);
86: 
87:   while (getreg32(RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST) & RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST_VLD)
88:     {
89:       getreg32(RP2040_SIO_FIFO_RD);
90:     }
91: 
92:   __asm__ volatile ("sev");
93: }

95: /****************************************************************************
96:  * Name: fifo_comm
97:  *
98:  * Description:
99:  *   Communicate with CPU Core 1 using inter-processor FIFO for boot
100:  *
101:  * Input Parameters:
102:  *   msg - Data to be sent to Core 1
103:  *
104:  * Returned Value:
105:  *   true on success; false on failure.
106:  *
107:  ****************************************************************************/
108: 
109: static int fifo_comm(uint32_t msg)
110: {
111:   uint32_t rcv;
112: 
113:   while (!(getreg32(RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST) & RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST_RDY))
114:     ;
115:   putreg32(msg, RP2040_SIO_FIFO_WR);
116:   __asm__ volatile ("sev");
117: 
118:   while (!(getreg32(RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST) & RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST_VLD))
119:     __asm__ volatile ("wfe");
120: 
121:   rcv = getreg32(RP2040_SIO_FIFO_RD);
122: 
123:   return msg == rcv;
124: }

143:   arm_initialize_stack();
144: #endif

153: 
154:   irq_attach(RP2040_SMP_CALL_PROC1, rp2040_smp_call_handler, NULL);
155:   up_enable_irq(RP2040_SMP_CALL_PROC1);
156: 
157:   spin_unlock(&g_core1_boot);

162:   sched_note_cpu_started(this_task());
163: #endif
164:

166: 
167:   nx_idle_trampoline();
168: }

174: /****************************************************************************
175:  * Name: up_cpu_start
176:  *
177:  * Description:
178:  *   In an SMP configuration, only one CPU is initially active (CPU 0).
179:  *   System initialization occurs on that single thread. At the completion of
180:  *   the initialization of the OS, just before beginning normal multitasking,
181:  *   the additional CPUs would be started by calling this function.
182:  *
183:  *   Each CPU is provided the entry point to its IDLE task when started.  A
184:  *   TCB for each CPU's IDLE task has been initialized and placed in the
185:  *   CPU's g_assignedtasks[cpu] list.  No stack has been allocated or
186:  *   initialized.
187:  *
188:  *   The OS initialization logic calls this function repeatedly until each
189:  *   CPU has been started, 1 through (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).
190:  *
191:  * Input Parameters:
192:  *   cpu - The index of the CPU being started.  This will be a numeric
193:  *         value in the range of one to (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).
194:  *         (CPU 0 is already active)
195:  *
196:  * Returned Value:
197:  *   Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
198:  *
199:  ****************************************************************************/
200: 
201: int up_cpu_start(int cpu)
202: {
203:   int i;
204:   struct tcb_s *tcb = current_task(cpu);
205:   uint32_t core1_boot_msg[5];
206: 
207:   DPRINTF("cpu=%d\n", cpu);
208: 
209: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_INSTRUMENTATION
210:   /* Notify of the start event */
211: 
212:   sched_note_cpu_start(this_task(), cpu);
213: #endif
214: 
215:   /* Reset Core 1 */
216: 
217:   setbits_reg32(RP2040_PSM_PROC1, RP2040_PSM_FRCE_OFF);
218:   while (!(getreg32(RP2040_PSM_FRCE_OFF) & RP2040_PSM_PROC1))
219:     ;
220:   clrbits_reg32(RP2040_PSM_PROC1, RP2040_PSM_FRCE_OFF);
221: 
222:   spin_lock(&g_core1_boot);
223: 
224:   /* Send initial VTOR, MSP, PC for Core 1 boot */
225: 
226:   core1_boot_msg[0] = 0;
227:   core1_boot_msg[1] = 1;
228:   core1_boot_msg[2] = getreg32(ARMV6M_SYSCON_VECTAB);
229:   core1_boot_msg[3] = (uint32_t)tcb->stack_base_ptr +
230:                                 tcb->adj_stack_size;
231:   core1_boot_msg[4] = (uint32_t)core1_boot;
232: 
233:   do
234:     {
235:       fifo_drain();
236:       for (i = 0; i < 5; i++)
237:         {
238:           if (!fifo_comm(core1_boot_msg[i]))
239:             {
240:               break;
241:             }
242:         }
243:     }
244:   while (i < 5);
245: 
246:   fifo_drain();
247: 
248:   /* Enable inter-processor FIFO interrupt */
249: 
250:   irq_attach(RP2040_SMP_CALL_PROC0, rp2040_smp_call_handler, NULL);
251:   up_enable_irq(RP2040_SMP_CALL_PROC0);
252: 
253:   spin_lock(&g_core1_boot);
254: 
255:   /* CPU Core 1 boot done */
256: 
257:   spin_unlock(&g_core1_boot);
258: 
259:   return 0;
260: }
261: 
262: #endif /* CONFIG_SMP */

22: extern const uint8_t _eronly[];
23: extern uint8_t _sdata[];
24: extern uint8_t _edata[];
25: extern uint8_t _sbss[];
26: extern uint8_t _ebss[];
27: extern uint8_t __ram_vectors_load[];
28: extern uint8_t __ram_vectors_start[];
29: extern uint8_t __ram_vectors_end[];
30: extern uint8_t __idle_stack_base[];
31: extern uint8_t __idle_stack_top[];
32: 
33: const uintptr_t g_idle_topstack = (uintptr_t)__idle_stack_top;
34: 
35: static const struct mpu_region_s g_bk7258_mpu_regions[] =
36: {
37:   {
38:     BK7258_AP_FLASH_BASE,
39:     BK7258_AP_FLASH_SIZE,
40:     MPU_RBAR_AP_RORO | MPU_RBAR_SH_NO,
41:     MPU_RLAR_WRITE_THROUGH
42:   },
43:   {
44:     BK7258_AP_RAM_BASE,
45:     BK7258_AP_RAM_SIZE,
46:     MPU_RBAR_XN | MPU_RBAR_AP_RWRW | MPU_RBAR_SH_INNER,
47:     MPU_RLAR_NONCACHEABLE
48:   },
49:   {
50:     0x40000000u,
51:     0x20000000u,
52:     MPU_RBAR_XN | MPU_RBAR_AP_RWRW | MPU_RBAR_SH_INNER,
53:     MPU_RLAR_DEVICE
54:   },
55: };
56: 
57: static void __attribute__((used, noinline, noreturn,
58:                            target("general-regs-only")))
59: bk7258_start(void)
60: {
61:   const uint8_t *src;
62:   uint8_t *dest;
63: 
64:   /* Enable CP10/CP11 before code compiled for the hard-float ABI can use the
65:    * floating-point extension.
66:    */
67: 
68:   modifyreg32(NVIC_CPACR, 0,
69:               NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(10) | NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(11));
70:   UP_DSB();
71:   UP_ISB();
72: 
73:   /* Match the current golden SPE SAU setup: the secure alias is retained,
74:    * while the 0x10000000 non-secure alias range is exposed as non-secure.
75:    */
76: 
77:   putreg32(0, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
78:   putreg32(0x00000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
79:   putreg32(0x0fffffe3u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
80:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
81:   putreg32(0x10000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
82:   putreg32(0xefffffe1u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
83:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x00);
84:   UP_DSB();
85:   UP_ISB();
86: 
87:   for (src = _eronly, dest = _sdata; dest < _edata; )
88:     {
89:       *dest++ = *src++;
90:     }
91: 
92:   for (dest = _sbss; dest < _ebss; )
93:     {
94:       *dest++ = 0;
95:     }
96: 
97:   for (src = __ram_vectors_load, dest = __ram_vectors_start;
98:        dest < __ram_vectors_end; )
99:     {
100:       *dest++ = *src++;
101:     }
102: 
103:   putreg32((uintptr_t)__ram_vectors_start, NVIC_VECTAB);
104:   UP_DSB();
105:   UP_ISB();
106: 
107:   /* Install the buffered AP log channel before normal NuttX startup. */
108:   (void)bk7258_syslog_initialize();
109: 
110: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM_MPU
111:   mpu_reset();
112:   mpu_initialize(g_bk7258_mpu_regions,
113:                  sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions) /
114:                  sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions[0]),
115:                  false, true);
116: #endif
117: 
118: #ifdef USE_EARLYSERIALINIT
119:   arm_earlyserialinit();
120: #endif
121: 
122:   nx_start();
123:   for (; ; )
124:     {
125:     }
126: }
127: 
128: void __attribute__((naked, noreturn, section(".start_text"))) __start(void)
129: {
130:   __asm__ volatile
131:     (
132:       "cpsid i\n"
133:       "ldr r0, =__idle_stack_base\n"
134:       "msr msplim, r0\n"
135:       "b bk7258_start\n"
136:     );
137: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_irq.c
3:  *
4:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
5:  ****************************************************************************/
6: 
7: #include <nuttx/config.h>
8: 
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: 
11: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
12: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
13: 
14: #include <arch/arm_m/nvicpri.h>
15: 
16: #include "arm_internal.h"
17: #include "nvic.h"
18: 
19: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
20: 
21: #define DEFPRIORITY32 \
22:   (NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 24 | \
23:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 16 | \
24:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 8  | \
25:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT)
26: 
27: static inline void bk7258_route_irq(int extirq, bool enable)
28: {
29:   uintptr_t regaddr;
30:   uint32_t bit;
31: 
32:   if (extirq < 32)
33:     {
34:       regaddr = BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0;
35:       bit = 1u << extirq;
36:     }
37:   else
38:     {
39:       regaddr = BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1;
40:       bit = 1u << (extirq - 32);
41:     }
42: 
43:   if (enable)
44:     {
45:       modifyreg32(regaddr, 0, bit);
46:     }
47:   else
48:     {
49:       modifyreg32(regaddr, bit, 0);
50:     }
51: }
52: 
53: static int bk7258_irqinfo(int irq, uintptr_t *regaddr, uint32_t *bit,
54:                           uintptr_t offset)
55: {
56:   int extirq;
57: 
58:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7258_IRQ_NMI && irq < NR_IRQS);
59: 
60:   if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
61:     {
62:       extirq = irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST;
63:       *regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_ENABLE(extirq) + offset;
64:       *bit = 1u << (extirq & 31);
65:       return OK;
66:     }
67: 
68:   *regaddr = NVIC_SYSHCON;
69:   switch (irq)
70:     {
71:       case BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT:
72:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_MEMFAULTENA;
73:         break;
74:       case BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT:
75:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_BUSFAULTENA;
76:         break;
77:       case BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT:
78:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_USGFAULTENA;
79:         break;
80:       case BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT:
81:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_SECUREFAULTENA;
82:         break;
83:       case BK7258_IRQ_SYSTICK:
84:         *regaddr = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL;
85:         *bit = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE;
86:         break;
87:       default:
88:         return ERROR;
89:     }
90: 
91:   return OK;
92: }
93: 
94: static inline void bk7258_prioritize_svcall(int priority)
95: {
96:   uint32_t regval = getreg32(NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
97:   regval &= ~NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_MASK;
98:   regval |= priority << NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_SHIFT;
99:   putreg32(regval, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
100: }
101: 
102: void up_irqinitialize(void)
103: {
104:   uintptr_t regaddr;
105:   int priority_registers;
106:   int i;
107: 
108:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_EXTIRQ_COUNT; i += 32)
109:     {
110:       putreg32(0xffffffffu, NVIC_IRQ_CLEAR(i));
111:     }
112: 
113:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0);
114:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1);
115: 
116:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH4_7_PRIORITY);
117:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
118:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);
119: 
120:   priority_registers = ((getreg32(NVIC_ICTR) & 0x1f) + 1) * 8;
121:   regaddr = NVIC_IRQ0_3_PRIORITY;
122:   while (priority_registers-- > 0)
123:     {
124:       putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, regaddr);
125:       regaddr += 4;
126:     }
127: 
128:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SVCALL, arm_svcall, NULL);
129:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_HARDFAULT, arm_hardfault, NULL);
130:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT, arm_memfault, NULL);
131:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT, arm_busfault, NULL);
132:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT, arm_usagefault, NULL);
133:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT, arm_securefault, NULL);
134:   arm_enable_dbgmonitor();
135:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_DBGMONITOR, arm_dbgmonitor, NULL);
136: 
137:   bk7258_prioritize_svcall(NVIC_SYSH_SVCALL_PRIORITY);
138:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT);
139:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT);
140:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT);
141:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT);
142:   up_irq_enable();
143: }
144: 
145: void up_enable_irq(int irq)
146: {
147:   uintptr_t regaddr;
148:   uint32_t regval;
149:   uint32_t bit;
150: 
151:   if (bk7258_irqinfo(irq, &regaddr, &bit, 0) == OK)
152:     {
153:       if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
154:         {
155:           bk7258_route_irq(irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST, true);
156:           putreg32(bit, regaddr);
157:         }
158:       else
159:         {
160:           regval = getreg32(regaddr);
161:           putreg32(regval | bit, regaddr);
162:         }
163:     }
164: }
165: 
166: void up_disable_irq(int irq)
167: {
168:   uintptr_t regaddr;
169:   uint32_t regval;
170:   uint32_t bit;
171: 
172:   if (bk7258_irqinfo(irq, &regaddr, &bit,
173:                      NVIC_IRQ0_31_CLEAR - NVIC_IRQ0_31_ENABLE) == OK)
174:     {
175:       if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
176:         {
177:           putreg32(bit, regaddr);
178:           bk7258_route_irq(irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST, false);
179:         }
180:       else
181:         {
182:           regval = getreg32(regaddr);
183:           putreg32(regval & ~bit, regaddr);
184:         }
185:     }
186: }
187: 
188: void arm_ack_irq(int irq)
189: {
190: }
191: 
192: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_IRQPRIO
193: int up_prioritize_irq(int irq, int priority)
194: {
195:   uintptr_t regaddr;
196:   uint32_t regval;
197:   int shift;
198: 
199:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT && irq < NR_IRQS);
200:   DEBUGASSERT((unsigned int)priority <= NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MIN);
201: 
202:   if (irq < BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
203:     {
204:       regaddr = NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY(irq);
205:       irq -= 4;
206:     }
207:   else
208:     {
209:       irq -= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST;
210:       regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_PRIORITY(irq);
211:     }
212: 
213:   shift = (irq & 3) << 3;
214:   regval = getreg32(regaddr);
215:   regval &= ~(0xffu << shift);
216:   regval |= (uint32_t)priority << shift;
217:   putreg32(regval, regaddr);
218:   return OK;
219: }
220: #endif

18: typedef void (*vector_t)(void);

20: /* CPU0 starts CPU1 at the AP image origin, so this table must remain at raw
21:  * image offset zero. The BK legacy words at 0x100 make it unsuitable as the

46: void exception_direct(void)
47: {
48:   int irq;
49: 
50:   up_addrenv_enter_kernel();
51:   irq = getipsr();
52: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_FPU
53:   __asm__ __volatile__
54:     (
55:       "mov r0, %0\n"
56:       "vmsr fpscr, r0\n"
57:       :
58:       : "i" (ARM_FPSCR_LTPSIZE_NONE)
59:     );
60: #endif
61: 
62:   arm_ack_irq(irq);
63:   irq_dispatch(irq, NULL);
64: 
65:   if (g_running_task != this_task())
66:     {
67:       up_trigger_irq(NVIC_IRQ_PENDSV, 0);
68:     }
69: 
70:   up_addrenv_leave_kernel();
71: }
72: 
73: uint32_t *arm_doirq(int irq, uint32_t *regs)
74: {
75:   struct tcb_s **running_task;
76:   struct tcb_s *tcb;
77: 
78:   up_addrenv_enter_kernel();
79:   running_task = &g_running_task;
80:   tcb = *running_task;
81: 
82:   /* This judgment proves that (*running_task)->xcp.regs
83:    * is invalid, and we can safely overwrite it.
84:    * And suspend the scheduler for the current task.
85:    */
86: 
87:   if (tcb != NULL)
88:     {
89:       tcb->xcp.regs = regs;
90:       nxsched_suspend_scheduler(tcb);
91:     }
92: 
93:   board_autoled_on(LED_INIRQ);
94: #ifdef CONFIG_SUPPRESS_INTERRUPTS
95:   PANIC();
96: #else
97: 
98:   /* Acknowledge the interrupt */
99: 
100:   arm_ack_irq(irq);
101: 
102:   if (irq == NVIC_IRQ_PENDSV)
103:     {
104: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_HIPRI_INTERRUPT
105:       /* Dispatch the PendSV interrupt */
106: 
107:       irq_dispatch(irq, regs);
108: #endif
109: #ifndef CONFIG_DISABLE_SIGNALS
110:       if (tcb && tcb->sigdeliver && !tcb->xcp.saved_regs)
111:         {
112:           /* Pendsv able to access running tcb with no critical section */
113: 
114:           up_schedule_sigaction(tcb);
115:         }
116: #endif
117: 
118:       up_irq_save();
119:     }
120:   else
121:     {
122:       irq_dispatch(irq, regs);
123:     }
124: 
125:   tcb = this_task();
126: 
127:   if (*running_task != tcb)
128:     {
129: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_ADDRENV
130:       /* Make sure that the address environment for the previously
131:        * running task is closed down gracefully (data caches dump,
132:        * MMU flushed) and set up the address environment for the new
133:        * thread at the head of the ready-to-run list.
134:        */
135: 
136:       addrenv_switch(tcb);
137:       tcb = this_task();
138: #endif
139: 
140:       /* Record the new "running" task when context switch occurred.
141:        * g_running_tasks[] is only used by assertion logic for reporting
142:        * crashes.
143:        */
144: 
145:       *running_task = tcb;
146:     }
147: 
148:   /* Resume the new task (or the same task if no context switch) */
149: 
150:   nxsched_resume_scheduler(tcb);
151: 
152:   regs = tcb->xcp.regs;
153: #endif
154: 
155:   board_autoled_off(LED_INIRQ);
156: 
157: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_TRUSTZONE_HYBRID
158:   if (((1 << this_cpu()) & CONFIG_ARMV8M_TRUSTZONE_CPU_BITMASK) == 0)
159:     {
160:       regs[REG_EXC_RETURN] &=
161:         ~(EXC_RETURN_EXC_SECURE | EXC_RETURN_SECURE_STACK);
162:     }
163:   else
164:     {
165:       regs[REG_EXC_RETURN] |=
166:         (EXC_RETURN_EXC_SECURE | EXC_RETURN_SECURE_STACK);
167:     }
168: #endif
169: 
170:   /* (*running_task)->xcp.regs is about to become invalid
171:    * and will be marked as NULL to avoid misusage.
172:    */
173: 
174:   (*running_task)->xcp.regs = NULL;
175:   up_addrenv_leave_kernel();
176:   return regs;
177: }

42: /****************************************************************************
43:  * Name: up_initial_state
44:  *
45:  * Description:
46:  *   A new thread is being started and a new TCB
47:  *   has been created. This function is called to initialize
48:  *   the processor specific portions of the new TCB.
49:  *
50:  *   This function must setup the initial architecture registers
51:  *   and/or  stack so that execution will begin at tcb->start
52:  *   on the next context switch.
53:  *
54:  ****************************************************************************/
55: 
56: void up_initial_state(struct tcb_s *tcb)
57: {
58:   struct xcptcontext *xcp = &tcb->xcp;
59: 
60:   /* Initialize the initial exception register context structure */
61: 
62:   memset(xcp, 0, sizeof(struct xcptcontext));
63: 
64:   /* Initialize the idle thread stack */
65: 
66:   if (tcb->pid == IDLE_PROCESS_ID)
67:     {
68:       tcb->stack_alloc_ptr = (void *)(g_idle_topstack -
69:                                       CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE);
70:       tcb->stack_base_ptr  = tcb->stack_alloc_ptr;
71:       tcb->adj_stack_size  = CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE;
72: 
73: #ifdef CONFIG_STACK_COLORATION
74:       /* If stack debug is enabled, then fill the stack with a
75:        * recognizable value that we can use later to test for high
76:        * water marks.
77:        */
78: 
79:       arm_stack_color(tcb->stack_alloc_ptr, 0);
80: #endif /* CONFIG_STACK_COLORATION */
81: 
82:       return;
83:     }
84: 
85:   /* Initialize the context registers to stack top */
86: 
87:   xcp->regs = (void *)((uint32_t)tcb->stack_base_ptr +
88:                                  tcb->adj_stack_size -
89:                                  XCPTCONTEXT_SIZE);
90: 
91:   /* Initialize the xcp registers */
92: 
93:   memset(xcp->regs, 0, XCPTCONTEXT_SIZE);
94: 
95:   /* Save the initial stack pointer */
96: 
97:   xcp->regs[REG_SP]      = (uint32_t)tcb->stack_base_ptr +
98:                                      tcb->adj_stack_size;
99: 
100: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK
101:   /* Set the stack limit value */
102: 
103:   xcp->regs[REG_R10]     = (uint32_t)tcb->stack_alloc_ptr + 64;
104: #endif
105: 
106: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
107:   /* Save the stack limit value, will be used in context switch. */
108: 
109:   xcp->regs[REG_SPLIM]   = (uint32_t)tcb->stack_alloc_ptr;
110: #endif
111: 
112:   /* Save the task entry point (stripping off the thumb bit) */
113: 
114:   xcp->regs[REG_PC]      = (uint32_t)tcb->start & ~1;
115: 
116:   /* Specify thumb mode */
117: 
118:   xcp->regs[REG_XPSR]    = ARM_XPSR_T;
119: 
120:   /* All tasks need to set pic address to special register */
121: 
122: #ifdef CONFIG_BUILD_PIC
123:   __asm__ ("mov %0, r9" : "=r"(xcp->regs[REG_R9]));
124: #endif
125: 
126:   /* If this task is running PIC, then set the PIC base register to the
127:    * address of the allocated D-Space region.
128:    */
129: 
130: #ifdef CONFIG_PIC
131:   if (tcb->dspace != NULL)
132:     {
133:       /* Set the PIC base register (probably R10) to the address of the
134:        * alloacated D-Space region.
135:        */
136: 
137:       xcp->regs[REG_PIC] = (uint32_t)tcb->dspace->region;
138:     }
139: 
140: #ifdef CONFIG_NXFLAT
141:   /* Make certain that bit 0 is set in the main entry address.  This
142:    * is only an issue when NXFLAT is enabled.  NXFLAT doesn't know
143:    * anything about thumb; the addresses that NXFLAT sets are based
144:    * on file header info and won't have bit 0 set.
145:    */
146: 
147:   tcb->entry.main = (main_t)((uint32_t)tcb->entry.main | 1);
148: #endif
149: #endif /* CONFIG_PIC */
150: 
151:   /* All tasks start via a stub function in kernel space.  So all
152:    * tasks must start in privileged thread mode.  If CONFIG_BUILD_PROTECTED
153:    * is defined, then that stub function will switch to unprivileged
154:    * mode before transferring control to the user task.
155:    */
156: 
157:   xcp->regs[REG_EXC_RETURN] = EXC_RETURN_THREAD;
158: 
159:   xcp->regs[REG_CONTROL] = getcontrol() & ~CONTROL_NPRIV;
160: 
161: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_FPU
162:   xcp->regs[REG_FPSCR]  |= ARM_FPSCR_LTPSIZE_NONE;
163: #endif /* CONFIG_ARCH_FPU */
164: 
165:   /* Enable or disable interrupts, based on user configuration */
166: 
167: #ifdef CONFIG_SUPPRESS_INTERRUPTS
168: 
169:   xcp->regs[REG_BASEPRI] = NVIC_SYSH_DISABLE_PRIORITY;
170: 
171: #else /* CONFIG_SUPPRESS_INTERRUPTS */
172: 
173:   xcp->regs[REG_BASEPRI] = 0;
174: 
175: #endif /* CONFIG_SUPPRESS_INTERRUPTS */
176: 
177: #if defined(CONFIG_BUILD_FLAT) && defined(CONFIG_ARCH_ADDRENV)
178:   xcp->nkernels = 1;
179: #endif
180: }

183: /****************************************************************************
184:  * Name: arm_initialize_stack
185:  *
186:  * Description:
187:  *   If interrupt stack is defined, the PSP and MSP need to be reinitialized.
188:  *
189:  ****************************************************************************/
190: 
191: noinline_function void arm_initialize_stack(void)
192: {
193:   uint32_t stacklim = up_get_intstackbase(this_cpu());
194:   uint32_t stack = stacklim + INTSTACK_SIZE;
195:   uint32_t temp = 0;
196: 
197:   __asm__ __volatile__
198:     (
199:       "mrs %1, CONTROL\n"
200:       "tst %1, #2\n"
201:       "bne 1f\n"
202: 
203:       /* Initialize PSP */
204: 
205:       "mrs %1, msp\n"
206:       "msr psp, %1\n"
207: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
208:       "mrs %1, msplim\n"
209:       "msr psplim, %1\n"
210: #else
211:       "mov %1, #0\n"
212:       "msr psplim, %1\n"
213: #endif
214:       "isb sy\n"
215: 
216:       /* Select PSP */
217: 
218:       "mrs %1, CONTROL\n"
219:       "orr %1, #2\n"
220:       "msr CONTROL, %1\n"
221:       "isb sy\n"
222: 
223:       /* Initialize MSP */
224: 
225:       "1:\n"
226:       "msr msp, %0\n"
227: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
228:       "msr msplim, %2\n"
229: #else
230:       "mov %1, #0\n"
231:       "msr msplim, %1\n"
232: #endif
233:       "isb sy\n"
234:       :
235: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
236:       : "r" (stack), "r" (temp), "r" (stacklim)
237: #else
238:       : "r" (stack), "r" (temp)
239: #endif
240:       : "memory");
241: }
242: #endif

102:       sam_ipc1_enableclk();
103:

105: 
106:       putreg32(0x1, SAM_IPC1_ICCR);
107:

109: 
110:       putreg32(0x1, SAM_IPC1_IECR);
111:       irq_attach(SAM_IRQ_SMP_CALL1, sam4cm_smp_call_handler, NULL);
112:       up_enable_irq(SAM_IRQ_SMP_CALL1);
113:     }
114: 
115:   spin_unlock(&g_cpu1_boot);
116: 
117: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_INSTRUMENTATION
118:   /* Notify that this CPU has started */
119: 
120:   sched_note_cpu_started(this_task());
121: #endif
122: 
123:   /* Then transfer control to the IDLE task */
124: 
125:   nx_idle_trampoline();

128: /****************************************************************************
129:  * Name: up_cpu_start
130:  *
131:  * Description:
132:  *   In an SMP configuration, only one CPU is initially active (CPU 0).
133:  *   System initialization occurs on that single thread. At the completion of
134:  *   the initialization of the OS, just before beginning normal multitasking,
135:  *   the additional CPUs would be started by calling this function.
136:  *
137:  *   Each CPU is provided the entry point to its IDLE task when started.  A
138:  *   TCB for each CPU's IDLE task has been initialized and placed in the
139:  *   CPU's g_assignedtasks[cpu] list.  No stack has been allocated or
140:  *   initialized.
141:  *
142:  *   The OS initialization logic calls this function repeatedly until each
143:  *   CPU has been started, 1 through (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).
144:  *
145:  * Input Parameters:
146:  *   cpu - The index of the CPU being started.  This will be a numeric
147:  *         value in the range of one to (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).
148:  *         (CPU 0 is already active)
149:  *
150:  * Returned Value:
151:  *   Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
152:  *
153:  ****************************************************************************/
154: 
155: int up_cpu_start(int cpu)
156: {
157:   struct tcb_s *tcb = current_task(cpu);
158: 
159:   DPRINTF("cpu=%d\n", cpu);
160: 
161:   if (cpu != 1)
162:     {
163:       return -EINVAL;
164:     }
165: 
166: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_INSTRUMENTATION
167:   /* Notify of the start event */
168: 
169:   sched_note_cpu_start(this_task(), cpu);
170: #endif
171: 
172:   /* Reset coprocessor */
173: 
174:   putreg32(0x5a000000, SAM_RSTC_CPMR);
175: 
176:   /* Enable Coprocessor Bus Master Clock (write-only) */
177: 
178:   putreg32(PMC_CPKEY | PMC_CPBMCK, SAM_PMC_SCER);
179: 
180:   /* Enable Coprocessor Clock (write-only) */
181: 
182:   putreg32(PMC_CPKEY | PMC_CPCK, SAM_PMC_SCER);
183: 
184:   /* Set Coprocessor Clock Prescalar */
185: 
186:   modifyreg32(SAM_PMC_MCKR, PMC_MCKR_CPPRES_MASK, 0);
187: 
188:   /* Set Coprocessor Clock Source */
189: 
190:   modifyreg32(SAM_PMC_MCKR, PMC_MCKR_CPCSS_MASK, PMC_MCKR_CPCSS_PLLB);
191: 
192:   /* Unreset coprocessor pheripheral */
193: 
194:   putreg32(0x5a000010, SAM_RSTC_CPMR);
195: 
196:   /* Enable clock for SRAM1 where CPU1 starts (write-only) */
197: 
198:   putreg32(PMC_PID42, SAM_PMC_PCER1);
199: 
200:   /* Clear SRAM1 */
201: 
202:   memset((void *)SAM_INTSRAM1_BASE, 0, 16 * 1024);
203: 
204:   /* Copy initial vectors for CPU1 */
205: 
206:   putreg32((uint32_t)tcb->stack_base_ptr +
207:                      tcb->adj_stack_size, CPU1_VECTOR_ISTACK);
208:   putreg32((uint32_t)cpu1_boot, CPU1_VECTOR_RESETV);
209: 
210:   spin_lock(&g_cpu1_boot);
211: 
212:   /* Unreset coprocessor */
213: 
214:   putreg32(0x5a000011, SAM_RSTC_CPMR);
215: 
216:   /* IRQ setup CPU1->CPU0 */
217: 
218:   sam_ipc0_enableclk();
219:   putreg32(0x1, SAM_IPC0_ICCR); /* clear : write-only */
220:   putreg32(0x1, SAM_IPC0_IECR); /* enable : write-only */
221:   irq_attach(SAM_IRQ_SMP_CALL0, sam4cm_smp_call_handler, NULL);

38:  *
39:  * Description:
40:  *   Allocate a stack for the CPU[n] IDLE task (n > 0) if appropriate and
41:  *   setup up stack-related information in the IDLE task's TCB.  This
42:  *   function is always called before up_cpu_start().  This function is
43:  *   only called for the CPU's initial IDLE task; up_create_task is used for
44:  *   all normal tasks, pthreads, and kernel threads for all CPUs.
45:  *
46:  *   The initial IDLE task is a special case because the CPUs can be started
47:  *   in different wans in different environments:
48:  *
49:  *   1. The CPU may already have been started and waiting in a low power
50:  *      state for up_cpu_start().  In this case, the IDLE thread's stack
51:  *      has already been allocated and is already in use.  Here
52:  *      up_cpu_idlestack() only has to provide information about the
53:  *      already allocated stack.
54:  *
55:  *   2. The CPU may be disabled but started when up_cpu_start() is called.
56:  *      In this case, a new stack will need to be created for the IDLE
57:  *      thread and this function is then equivalent to:
58:  *
59:  *      return up_create_stack(tcb, stack_size, TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL);
60:  *
61:  *   The following TCB fields must be initialized by this function:
62:  *
63:  *   - adj_stack_size: Stack size after adjustment for hardware, processor,
64:  *     etc.  This value is retained only for debug purposes.
65:  *   - stack_alloc_ptr: Pointer to allocated stack
66:  *   - stack_base_ptr: Adjusted stack base pointer after the TLS Data and
67:  *     Arguments has been removed from the stack allocation.
68:  *
69:  * Input Parameters:
70:  *   - cpu:         CPU index that indicates which CPU the IDLE task is
71:  *                  being created for.
72:  *   - tcb:         The TCB of new CPU IDLE task
73:  *   - stack_size:  The requested stack size for the IDLE task.  At least
74:  *                  this much must be allocated.  This should be
75:  *                  CONFIG_SMP_STACK_SIZE.
76:  *
77:  ****************************************************************************/
78: 
79: int up_cpu_idlestack(int cpu, struct tcb_s *tcb, size_t stack_size)
80: {
81: #if CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS > 1
82:   up_create_stack(tcb, stack_size, TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL);
83: #endif
84:   return OK;
85: }

434: 	---help---
435: 		Enables support for Bound Multi-Processing (BMP) on a multi-CPU
436: 		platform. Bound multiprocessing provides the scheduling control
437: 		of an asymmetric multiprocessing model, while preserving the
438: 		hardware abstraction and management of symmetric multiprocessing.
439: 
440: 		BMP is similar to SMP, but you can specify which processors a thread
441: 		can run on. You can use both SMP and BMP on the same system, allowing
442: 		some threads to migrate from one processor to another, while other
443: 		threads are restricted to one or more processors.
444: 
445: 		As with SMP, a single copy of the OS maintains an overall view of all
446: 		system resources, allowing them to be dynamically allocated and shared
447: 		among applications. But, during application initialization, a setting
448: 		determined by the system designer forces all of an application's threads
449: 		to execute only on a specified CPU.
450: 
451: 		Compared to full, floating SMP operation, this approach offers several
452: 		advantages:
453: 
454: 		1. It eliminates the cache thrashing that can reduce performance in an SMP
455: 		system by allowing applications that share the same data set to run
456: 		exclusively on the same CPU.
457: 		2. It offers simpler application debugging than SMP since all execution
458: 		threads within an application run on a single CPU.
459: 		3. It helps legacy applications that use poor techniques for synchronizing

52: /****************************************************************************
53:  * Pre-processor Definitions
54:  ****************************************************************************/
55: 
56: /* Configuration ************************************************************/
57: 
58: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_HIPRI_INTERRUPT
59:   /* In protected mode without an interrupt stack, this interrupt handler will set the
60:    * MSP to the stack pointer of the interrupted thread.  If the interrupted thread
61:    * was a privileged thread, that will be the MSP otherwise it will be the PSP.  If
62:    * the PSP is used, then the value of the MSP will be invalid when the interrupt
63:    * handler returns because it will be a pointer to an old position in the
64:    * unprivileged stack.  Then when the high priority interrupt occurs and uses this
65:    * stale MSP, there will most likely be a system failure.
66:    *
67:    * If the interrupt stack is selected, on the other hand, then the interrupt
68:    * handler will always set the MSP to the interrupt stack.  So when the high
69:    * priority interrupt occurs, it will either use the MSP of the last privileged
70:    * thread to run or, in the case of the nested interrupt, the interrupt stack if
71:    * no privileged task has run.
72:    */
73: 
74: #  if defined(CONFIG_BUILD_PROTECTED) && CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK < 8
75: #    error Interrupt stack must be used with high priority interrupts in protected mode
76: #  endif
77: #endif
78: 
79: /****************************************************************************
80:  * Public Symbols
81:  ****************************************************************************/
82: 
83: 	.globl		exception_common
84: #ifdef __ghs__
85: 	.thumb2
86: #else
87: 	.syntax		unified
88: 	.thumb
89: #endif
90: 	.file		"arm_exception.S"
91: 
92: /****************************************************************************
93:  * .text
94:  ****************************************************************************/
95: 
96: /* Common exception handling logic.  On entry here, the return stack is on either
97:  * the PSP or the MSP and looks like the following:
98:  *
99:  *      REG_XPSR
100:  *      REG_R15
101:  *      REG_R14
102:  *      REG_R12
103:  *      REG_R3
104:  *      REG_R2
105:  *      REG_R1
106:  * MSP->REG_R0
107:  *
108:  * And
109:  *      IPSR contains the IRQ number
110:  *      R14 Contains the EXC_RETURN value
111:  *      We are in handler mode and the current SP is the MSP
112:  *
113:  * If CONFIG_ARCH_FPU is defined, the volatile FP registers and FPSCR are on the
114:  * return stack immediately above REG_XPSR.
115:  */
116: 
117: 	.text
118: 	.align 2
119: 	.section    .text.exception_common, "ax"
120: #ifdef __ghs__
121: 	.type	exception_common, $function
122: #else
123: 	.thumb_func
124: 	.syntax	unified
125: 	.type	exception_common, function
126: #endif
127: exception_common:
128: 	.cfi_sections	.debug_frame
129: 	.cfi_startproc
130: 	mrs		r12, control				/* R12=control */
131: 
132: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
133: 	mov		r3, #0x0
134: #endif
135: 	/* Complete the context save */
136: 
137: 	/* The EXC_RETURN value tells us whether the context is on the MSP or PSP */
138: 
139: 	mov		r0, r14					/* Copy EXC_RETURN */
140: 	lsls		r0, #(31 - EXC_RETURN_PROCESS_BITNO)	/* Move to bit 31 */
141: 	bpl		1f					/* Test bit 31 */
142: 	mrs		r1, psp					/* R1=The process stack pointer (PSP) */
143: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
144: 	mrs		r0, psplim
145: 	msr		psplim, r3
146: #endif
147: 	b		2f
148: 1:
149: 	mrs		r1, msp					/* R1=The main stack pointer (MSP) */
150: 	mov		r0, r1					/* Keep r1 not changed for push */
151: 	subs		r0, #SW_XCPT_SIZE			/* Reserve MSP for SW_XCPT_SIZE */
152: 	msr		msp, r0					/* Reserved stack space */
153: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
154: 	mrs		r0, msplim
155: 	msr		msplim, r3
156: #endif
157: 	isb		sy
158: 2:
159: 	mov		r2, r1					/* R2=Copy of the main/process stack pointer */
160: 	adds		r2, #HW_XCPT_SIZE			/* R2=MSP/PSP before the interrupt was taken */
161: 								/* (ignoring the xPSR[9] alignment bit) */
162: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
163: 	stmdb		r1!, {r0, r3}
164: #endif
165: 
166: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV6M
167: 	mrs		r3, primask				/* R3=Current PRIMASK setting */
168: #else
169: 	mrs		r3, basepri				/* R3=Current BASEPRI setting */
170: #endif /* CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV6M */
171: 
172: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_FPU
173: 
174: 	/* Save the non-volatile FP registers here.
175: 	 *
176: 	 * This routine is the only point where we can save these registers; either before
177: 	 * or after calling arm_doirq.  The compiler is free to use them at any time as long
178: 	 * as they are restored before returning, so we can't assume that we can get at the
179: 	 * true values of these registers in any routine called from here.
180: 	 *
181: 	 * REVISIT: we could do all this saving lazily on the context switch side if we knew
182: 	 * where to put the registers.
183: 	 */
184: 
185: 	/* Switched-out task including volatile FP registers ? */
186: 
187: 	tst		r14, #EXC_RETURN_STD_CONTEXT
188: 	ite		eq
189: 	vstmdbeq	r1!, {s16-s31}			/* Save the non-volatile FP context */
190: 	subne		r1, #(4*SW_FPU_REGS)
191: 
192: 	/* the FPSCR[18:16] LTPSIZE field must be set to 0b100 for
193: 	 * "Tail predication not applied" as it's reset value.
194: 	 */
195: 
196: 	mov		r0, #ARM_FPSCR_LTPSIZE_NONE
197: 	vmsr		fpscr, r0
198: #endif
199: 
200: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV6M
201: 	subs		r1, #(4*SW_INT_REGS)		/* Move cursor to base, for save low regs first */
202: 	mov		r0, r1				/* Copy the context array pointer */
203: 	stmia		r0!, {r2-r7}			/* Save the SP, PRIMASK, and R4-R7 in the context array */
204: 
205: 	/* Save R8-R11 control and the EXEC_RETURN value in the context array */
206: 
207: 	mov		r2, r8				/* Copy high registers to low */
208: 	mov		r3, r9
209: 	mov		r4, r10
210: 	mov		r5, r11
211: 	mrs		r6, control			/* R6=control */
212: 	mov		r7, r14
213: 	stmia		r0!, {r2-r7}			/* Save the high registers r8-r11 control and r14 */
214: #else
215: 	stmdb		r1!, {r2-r12,r14}		/* Save the remaining registers plus the SP/PRIMASK values */
216: #endif /* CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV6M */
217: 
218: 	/* There are two arguments to arm_doirq:
219: 	 *
220: 	 *   R0 = The IRQ number
221: 	 *   R1 = The top of the stack points to the saved state
222: 	 */
223: 
224: 	mrs		r0, ipsr			/* R0=exception number */
225: 
226: #if CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK < 7
227: 	/* If CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK is not defined, we will reuse the
228: 	 * interrupted thread's stack.  That may mean using either MSP or PSP
229: 	 * stack for interrupt level processing (in kernel mode).
230: 	 */
231: 
232: 	/* If the interrupt stack is disabled, reserve xcpcontext to ensure
233: 	 * that signal processing can have a separate xcpcontext to handle
234: 	 * signal context (reference: arm_schedulesigaction.c):
235: 	 *      ----------------------
236: 	 *     |    IRQ XCP context   |
237: 	 *      ----------------------
238: 	 *     |  Signal XCP context  |
239: 	 *      ----------------------   <- SP
240: 	 * also the sp should be restore after arm_doirq()
241: 	 */
242: 
243: 	mov		r2, r14
244: 	lsls		r2, #(31 - EXC_RETURN_THREAD_BITNO)	/* Move to bit 31 */
245: 	bpl		3f					/* Test bit 31 */
246: #ifndef CONFIG_DISABLE_SIGNALS
247: 	mov		r2, r1
248: 	subs		r2, #XCPTCONTEXT_SIZE			/* Reserve signal context */
249: 	movs		r4, #7
250: 	bics		r2, r4					/* Get the stack pointer with 8-byte alignment */
251: 	mov		sp, r2					/* Instantiate the aligned stack */
252: #endif
253: 3:
254: #endif
255: 	mov		fp,	r1
256: 	.cfi_def_cfa	fp,	0				/* Register in fp, so we just set fp as frame */
257: 	.cfi_offset	pc,	REG_PC	*	4
258: 	.cfi_offset	sp,	REG_SP	*	4
259: 	.cfi_offset	lr,	REG_LR	*	4
260: 	bl		arm_doirq				/* R0=IRQ, R1=register save (msp) */
261: 
262: 	/* On return from arm_doirq, R0 will hold a pointer to register context
263: 	 * array to use for the interrupt return.
264: 	 */
265: 
266: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV6M
267: 	/* Recover R8-R11 and EXEC_RETURN (5 registers) */
268: 
269: 	movs		r2, #(4*REG_R8)		/* R2=Offset to R8 storage */
270: 	adds		r1, r0, r2		/* R1=Address of R8 storage */
271: 	ldmia		r1!, {r2-r7}		/* Recover R8-R11 control and R14 (6 registers)*/
272: 	mov		r8, r2			/* Move to position in high registers */
273: 	mov		r9, r3
274: 	mov		r10, r4
275: 	mov		r11, r5
276: 	msr		control, r6
277: 	mov		r14, r7			/* EXEC_RETURN */
278: 
279: 	/* Recover SP (R2), PRIMASK (R3), and R4-R7. Determine the value of
280: 	 * the stack pointer as it was on entry to the exception handler.
281: 	 */
282: 
283: 	movs		r1, #(4*REG_R8)		/* Already restored offset */
284: 	ldmia		r0!, {r2-r7}		/* Recover R4-R7 + 2 temp values */
285: 	adds		r0, r0, r1		/* Fix already restored R8-R11 and R14 popped address */
286: #else
287: 	ldmia		r0!, {r2-r12,r14}	/* Recover R4-R12, r14 + 2 temp values */
288: #endif /* CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV6M */
289: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_FPU
290: 	/* Switched-in task including volatile FP registers ? */
291: 
292: 	tst		r14, #EXC_RETURN_STD_CONTEXT
293: 	ite		eq
294: 	vldmiaeq	r0!, {s16-s31}		/* Recover S16-S31 */
295: 	addne		r0, #(4*SW_FPU_REGS)
296: #endif
297: 
298: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
299: 	ldmia		r0!, {r1}		/* Get psplim/msplim */
300: 	add		r0, r0, #4
301: #endif
302: 
303: 	/* The EXC_RETURN value tells us whether we are returning on the MSP or PSP
304: 	 */
305: 
306: 	mov		r2, r14					/* Copy EXC_RETURN */
307: 	lsls		r2, #(31 - EXC_RETURN_PROCESS_BITNO)	/* Move to bit 31 */
308: 	bmi		4f					/* Test bit 31 */
309: 	msr		msp, r0					/* R1=The main stack pointer */
310: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
311: 	msr		msplim, r1
312: #endif
313: 	b		5f
314: 4:
315: 	msr		psp, r0					/* R1=The process stack pointer */
316: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
317: 	msr		psplim, r1
318: #endif
319: 5:
320: 	isb		sy
321: 
322: 	/* Restore the interrupt state */
323: 
324: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV6M
325: 	msr		primask, r3				/* Restore interrupts priority masking*/
326: #else
327: 	msr		basepri, r3				/* Restore interrupts priority masking */
328: #endif /* CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV6M */
329: 
330: 	msr		control, r12				/* Restore control */
331: 	isb		sy
332: 
333: 	/* Always return with R14 containing the special value that will: (1)
334: 	 * return to thread mode, and (2) select the correct stack.
335: 	 */
336: 
337: 	bx		r14					/* And return */
338: 	.cfi_endproc
339: 	.size	exception_common, .-exception_common
340: 
341: /****************************************************************************
342:  *  Name: g_intstackalloc/g_intstacktop
343:  *
344:  * Description:
345:  *   Shouldn't happen
346:  *
347:  ****************************************************************************/
348: 
349: #if !defined(CONFIG_SMP) && CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK > 7
350: 	.bss
351: 	.global	g_intstackalloc
352: 	.global	g_intstacktop
353: 	.balign	8
354: g_intstackalloc:
355: 	.skip	((CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK + 4) & ~7)
356: g_intstacktop:
357: 	.size	g_intstackalloc, .-g_intstackalloc
358: #endif
